scope: Only the 36 added lines in .github/workflows/ci.yml; supporting script/report generation, pipeline selection and artifact paths inspected to resolve wiring behavior.

checks.result: Existing two pure guard tests are added to the Backend test step. They reject production mode, missing disposable opt-in, nonliteral/remote hosts, URL overrides and non-generated cleanup identifiers before any database action.

The new Back step uses NODE_ENV=test, PHASE5_DB_QUALIFICATION=disposable, the existing owned PostgreSQL service loopback port and synthetic CI credentials. It runs after the normal build/migration/API validation. The executable creates a random generated database, qualifies it and drops only that database; there is no production or remote target.

The actual script must exit0; then parsed JSON must have statusPASS, source.head equal current GITHUB_SHA, exactly seven measurements, cleanup.created=true and cleanup.dropped=true. Script errors and cleanup errors exit nonzero. Invalid/missing JSON or false cleanup/provenance cannot satisfy the inline assertions.

The script always writes its own current HEAD provenance in finally, and the successful workflow explicitly compares it to GITHUB_SHA. No Back/reports files are tracked in this immutable tree and report directories are not restored by npm dependency caching.

Status functions occur in if expressions; with.if-no-files-found uses the supported steps outcome context with ordinary logical operators. Artifact upload uses the existing pinned approved action. Both success and failure attempt retention; success requires the single expected file, failure warns if setup prevented file creation.

Database and multi-API artifact names bind github.sha and github.run_attempt. Exact single-file paths are Back/reports/phase5-database.json and Back/reports/phase5-multi-api.json, with30day retention.

The existing test/*.pipeline-spec.ts glob includes the new spec and its path already selects full native validation. This delta adds retention to the existing real pipeline step rather than a separate mocked execution. Multi-API retention itself checks presence; PASS/assertion/provenance inspection remains coupled to the test and the required independent actual-artifact review.

Diff is strictly36 additions. Existing timeouts, resource classes, services, image/audit/native checks, existing artifact rules, permissions and CI-required dependencies are unchanged. Failure/cancellation remains blocking through the enclosing required jobs.

conditions: This acceptance is for root-authored CI wiring only and is not acceptance of the currently blocked multi-API lifecycle source.
Preserve and resolve PHASE5-MULTIAPI-001 in a separate immutable author correction; maintain full-native selection for any new helper paths.
Actual database/native qualification and final PASS/provenance/cleanup artifacts must be reviewed after CI before feature merge.
